sections.content: Combine the pretérito indefinido and ir a + infinitive in a short narrative. Say what happened before, then describe what someone is going to do next. Keep the past action completed and the future plan in the ir a + infinitive structure.

items.spanish: Escribimos las cartas y vamos a guardarlas.
items.english: We wrote the letters and are going to keep them.

items.spanish: Recordé los meses juntos y voy a escribir sobre ellos.
items.english: I remembered the months together and am going to write about them.

items.spanish: Terminamos las cartas y vamos a abrirlas el próximo año.
items.english: We finished the letters and are going to open them next year.

items.spanish: Vivieron en Hanói y van a recordar este año.
items.english: They lived in Hanoi and are going to remember this year.

sections.content: In ir a + infinitive, only ir is conjugated: voy a escribir, vas a escribir, vamos a escribir. Do not conjugate the second verb.
